Known accessible output-register type, trusted qutrit/ancilla gates, coherent whole-register SWAPs and quantum memory. No purification, inverse oracle, hidden flag, unknown eigenbasis or reusable decoder is supplied. Worst-case fixed unknown-source guarantees. The PHYSICAL collision component requires integer r>=2 and0<zeta<1. The separate all-real-p Choi component allows integer r>=1. Physical collision extension uses DIRECT latent-flag Haar symmetry. Choi lower uses exchangeable entropy increments, label-specific cancellation and dimension-normalized SU concentration. Copies are mixed; no channel purification or environment access.
